intro: Over the past three months, ZCyberNews has covered 25 articles tagged with law enforcement, published between April 12 and July 7, 2026. The reporting highlights activity from threat actors Scattered Spider, Black Axe, and BlackCat (ALPHV), primarily targeting government, telecommunications, financial services, law enforcement, and cryptocurrency sectors. Affected regions include the United States, Canada, North America, Europe, and France. The severity mix across these articles is 19 high, 4 medium, and 1 informational.
